# truenas_vm_stop (Action)

Stops a VM (vm.stop) and waits until it is down. Does nothing when the VM is already stopped.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Stop a VM (Terraform 1.14+) and wait until it is down. Does nothing when it
# is already stopped.
action "truenas_vm_stop" "example" {
  config {
    vm_id = truenas_vm.example.id
  }
}

# Stop a VM before Terraform removes its devices on destroy (Terraform
# 1.16+ for destroy events).
resource "truenas_vm_device" "disk" {
  vm = truenas_vm.example.id
  attributes = jsonencode({
    dtype = "DISK"
    path  = "/dev/zvol/tank/vms/example"
    type  = "VIRTIO"
  })

  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [before_destroy]
      actions = [action.truenas_vm_stop.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vm_id` (Number) ID of the VM to stop (truenas_vm.<name>.id).

### Optional

- `force` (Boolean) Power the VM off at once instead of asking the guest to shut down. Default false.
- `force_after_timeout` (Boolean) Power the VM off if the guest is still running after the VM's shutdown_timeout. Default true.
